title: Hoist the three port-call settle copies into one app/_server module
instrument: grep -c 'export (async )?function settle' app -> 3 before, 1 after; floor-settle, audio-hunt-return and library-screen tests green on both arms
body:
## Summary
One rule - a rejected Server Action answers as an `unavailable` refusal - is implemented three times in three routes.

## Description
app/(studio)/floor/_floor/settle.ts:16, app/(studio)/audio/_hunt/settled.ts:13 and (this round, 786089e2) app/(studio)/library/_library/blocks.ts settle. They already differ in wording: the Floor's carries the bare rejection message, the hunt's and the Library's prefix 'the studio did not answer: '. One module beside app/_server/actionCore.ts (whose ActionResult they all answer) removes the drift. Out of this context's paths (floor, audio, app/_server).

## Flow
- move settle to app/_server/settle.ts with one wording
- re-point the three importers
- keep floor-settle.test.ts and library-screen case 1; update their expected wording

## Expected impact
A future fix to the rejection shape lands once. Could break: the Floor's exact message, which floor-settle.test.ts pins.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one implementation of the rejection rule
Before: 3 copies, 2 wordings
After: 1 copy, 1 wording (predicted)
Method: simulation - the three sites read; the move is outside this context's paths
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
app/(studio)/floor/_floor/settle.ts:16 export function settle
app/(studio)/audio/_hunt/settled.ts:13 export async function settled
app/(studio)/library/_library/blocks.ts export function settle

title: The toolbar's 'rendered N of M' chip is the screen narrating its virtualisation
instrument: tests/live/library.live.spec.ts reads the figure from a data attribute on the listbox instead of [data-testid=rendered]; cx-capture library before/after shows the head without the chip and no gap
body:
## Summary
Toolbar.tsx:115 draws `rendered 42 of 5,000` - how many rows the DOM holds - as a visible chip in the results head.

## Description
CLAUDE.md's narration law: a sentence whose subject is the app's own mechanism goes. 'rendered N of M' is the window's DOM count (Results.tsx header: 'a number the live lane reads'); the work's figure, the total, is already the Tally beside it (Toolbar.tsx:112). The live lane is the chip's only reader, so the figure belongs in a data attribute, not on screen. Needs a live-lane change and a photograph, neither reachable this round (no dev server, no test:live).

## Flow
- move the count to data-rendered on the listbox (Results.tsx)
- point the live spec at it
- drop the chip and its .rendered rule
- cx-capture `library` at 1920 and 1280

## Expected impact
The results head says what the work holds, not how the page holds it. Could break: the live spec that reads the testid.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - one fewer mechanism readout in the head
Before: 1 visible chip narrating DOM state
After: 0 (predicted)
Method: simulation - the live lane and a capture are the instrument and both need a server
Result: better
Gate: none

body:
## Summary
DetailView.tsx:193 lists every project in the Use-in-project Select and defaults to the first, even one already using the item.

## Description
ShownDetail carries `usedBy` (present.ts:114, pinned by library-real.test.ts:120) and no screen reads it: grep usedBy over app/ and packages/ui/src finds only contract.ts and present.ts. So the operator can 'use' an item in a project that already uses it, with nothing on the control to say so; the facet line 'project' shows it elsewhere in the panel.

## Flow

- default to the first project not in usedBy
- test via a static render of DetailView

## Expected impact
The operator sees which projects already hold the item where the choice is made. Could break: a re-use the operator does want (so mark, do not hide).

## Evaluation

Before: 0 of 1 consumers of usedBy on screen
After: 1 (predicted)
Method: simulation - a UX choice (mark vs disable) the round did not make
Result: better

title: A detail read in flight is cancelled and re-asked on every server render
instrument: live spec counting library detail action POSTs while pressing a facet with a slow (page.route-delayed) detail: before 2+, after 1
body:
## Summary
Library.tsx's detail effect depends on `u.f`, a new object on every server render, so a read in flight is dropped and asked again.

## Description
parseUrl builds `f` afresh each render (url.ts), and router.refresh() after an act or any navigation re-renders the page; the effect's cleanup sets live=false and the body asks port.detail again for the same id. Facets only decide `pressed`, which the screen now derives itself (b82492f8 pressedBy), so the dependency could be the facet identity or dropped. No DOM in the unit lane to count the calls.

## Flow
- key the effect on identity(u) or drop u.f (pressedBy redraws the marks)
- count detail POSTs in the live lane on both arms

## Expected impact
One detail read per selection instead of one per render while it is in flight. Could break: the server-side `pressed` on first draw, which pressedBy overrides anyway.

## Evaluation
Claim: performance - detail reads per selection
Before: >=2 reads when a render lands mid-read (walked)
After: 1 (predicted)
Method: simulation - needs the live lane
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
app/(studio)/library/_library/Library.tsx detail effect deps [sel, details, failed, port, u.f]
app/(studio)/library/_library/url.ts parseUrl: const f: Record<string, string[]> = {}
